tasks.title: Create docwriter-knowledge-curator.agent.md
tasks.description: New specialist agent for Pass 0 (direct orchestrator dispatch). 7-step curation process: read index → build task profile → multi-factor relevance scoring (domain 40%, confidence 25%, recency 20%, usage 15%) → consumer-aware grouping → read + summarize entries (max 20, saturation guard) → staleness/conflict detection → compile knowledge-brief.json. Cold-start produces empty brief with taskProfile preserved.
acceptanceCriteria: Agent file has correct VS Code frontmatter (description, model, name, user-invocable: false)
Reads meta/index.json and all entry subdirectories
Multi-factor relevance scoring with threshold ≥0.4
Saturation guard caps brief at 20 entries
Consumer-aware grouping (P1: patterns/anti-patterns, P2: domain-insights/style-evolutions, P3: retro lessons)
Staleness detection (stale >90d/<3 uses, decaying >180d, contradicted)
Cold-start produces valid empty brief with taskProfile
Read-only against meta/ — never modifies index or entries
Writes knowledge-brief.json, status file, manifest prepend

tasks.title: Define knowledge-brief.json contract + curation quality principles
tasks.description: Document the output schema for knowledge-brief.json (patterns, antiPatterns, domainInsights, styleEvolutions, taskRetroLessons, staleEntries, conflicts, summary sections). Define 6 curation quality principles: relevance over completeness, consumer-aware grouping, evidence-backed confidence, proactive staleness detection, conflict transparency, profile preservation.
acceptanceCriteria: knowledge-brief.json schema fully specified with all sections
Each entry includes id, title, insight, applicability, confidence, relevanceScore, consumers
staleEntries section excludes entries from main knowledge sections
conflicts section surfaces disagreeing entries with resolution guidance
summary includes counts, threshold, truncated flag, coldStart flag

tasks.title: Create docwriter-research-scout.agent.md
tasks.description: New specialist agent dispatched by analysis-coordinator at Pass 2 Step 2b (parallel with code-analyzer). 5-step process: derive queries from change-inventory/doc-index → fetch curated sources (max 8 fetches) → extract recommendations with REC-NNN IDs → invariant gate (approved/blocked/adapted) → produce research-brief.json. Non-blocking failure mode.
acceptanceCriteria: Agent file has correct VS Code frontmatter
Reads from research-sources.json + derives queries from change-inventory/doc-index
Every recommendation has invariantCheck with explicit approved/blocked/adapted status
Blocked recommendations excluded from downstream-facing list
Fetch failures produce valid empty brief, not errors
Max 8 fetches total (time-boxed)
No hallucinated recommendations — all cite specific fetched URLs

tasks.description: Add research-scout to analysis-coordinator agents array. Reorder Pass 2: Step 1 invariant-scanner → Step 2a code-analyzer + Step 2b research-scout (parallel) → Step 3 impact-mapper. Add non-blocking failure handling for research-scout. Update progress.json with researchRecommendationsApproved count.
acceptanceCriteria: research-scout added to agents array in frontmatter
Pass 2 dispatches invariant-scanner BEFORE code-analyzer + research-scout

progress.json tracks researchRecommendationsApproved count

effectiveness field documented as synthesizer-updated

tasks.title: Create docwriter-synthesis-coordinator.agent.md
tasks.description: New coordinator for Pass 6.5 (direct orchestrator dispatch). Sequential dispatch of 4 subagents with validation between each: task-signal-analyzer → context-signal-analyzer → knowledge-integrator → skill-rebuilder. Degraded-mode handling (empty signals on analyzer failure). Writes synthesis-coordinator-status.json.
acceptanceCriteria: Frontmatter has agents array with 4 subagents
Sequential dispatch with validation between each step
Handles degraded mode (signal analyzer failure → empty signals → continue)
Only runs when pass6 === done AND gapHunting.reEntryTarget === null
Writes status file with per-step results and degraded flag

tasks.title: Create docwriter-task-signal-analyzer.agent.md
tasks.description: New specialist (synthesis Step 1). Reads all per-task artifacts (task-graph, review-feedback, writer-output, style/accuracy/persona reviews, progress). Extracts signal A1 (first-attempt success → candidate patterns), A2 (multi-cycle failure → candidate anti-patterns), A3 (style evolution detection). Writes synthesis-signals/task-signals.json.
acceptanceCriteria: Signal A1: first-attempt success analysis with strength calibration (low/medium/confirm-existing)
Signal A2: multi-cycle failure root cause analysis (structural/accuracy/tone/coverage/style)
Signal A3: style evolution detection from reviewer feedback patterns
task-signals.json includes runStats, per-task signals, styleEvolutions
Writes status file and manifest prepend

tasks.title: Create docwriter-context-signal-analyzer.agent.md
tasks.description: New specialist (synthesis Step 2). Reads global artifacts (gap-analysis, verification-matrix, code-analysis, impact-matrix, research-brief, knowledge-brief, research-sources, task-signals). Extracts signal B1 (gap findings), B2 (domain insights), B3 (research effectiveness), B4 (meta-knowledge effectiveness). Writes synthesis-signals/context-signals.json.
acceptanceCriteria: Signal B1: gap findings categorized as predictable vs. novel
Signal B2: domain-specific insights from code-analysis + impact-matrix
Signal B3: research recommendation effectiveness per source (originated/used ratio)
Signal B4: meta-knowledge effectiveness (patterns used, anti-patterns violated, over-included)
context-signals.json includes gapSignals, domainInsights, researchEffectiveness, metaKnowledgeEffectiveness

tasks.title: Create docwriter-knowledge-integrator.agent.md
tasks.description: New specialist (synthesis Step 3). Reads signal files + meta index + existing entries. 7-step process: confidence calibration (strict ladder: low/medium/high with explicit upgrade/downgrade rules) → dedup (type + title + domain overlap) → quality gate (reusability + actionability + non-redundancy) → write entry files → update index.json → write task retro → update research-sources.json effectiveness + deprecation heuristic.
acceptanceCriteria: Confidence calibration follows strict ladder (low→medium→high with criteria)
Deduplication uses type + title similarity + domain overlap (≥50%)
Quality gate enforces reusability + actionability + non-redundancy
Entry files include Provenance and 'How to Apply' sections
Task retro includes pipeline, knowledge, research, and failure breakdowns
Source effectiveness updated with deprecation heuristic (3 consecutive low/none runs)
Additive-only: no entries deleted, only deprecated
Confidence assignments follow the strict ladder — no arbitrary levels

tasks.title: Create docwriter-skill-rebuilder.agent.md
tasks.description: New specialist (synthesis Step 4). Reads meta index + all non-deprecated entry files + task-retros. Full-rebuild (never incremental) of 5 reference files (patterns.md, anti-patterns.md, domain-knowledge.md, style-decisions.md, task-effectiveness.md) grouped by domain + ordered by confidence/usage. Updates SKILL.md header with running stats.
acceptanceCriteria: All 5 reference files fully regenerated from index (full rebuild, never incremental)
Entries grouped by domain, ordered by confidence then usage count
SKILL.md header includes running stats (entry count, runs synthesized, avg acceptance)
Skill files are compile output — no merge logic, no drift

dependencyGraph._comment: Adjacency list: task → list of tasks that depend on it (children)

executionOrder._comment: Topologically sorted with parallelism annotations. Tasks at the same step have no mutual dependencies and can execute in parallel.

steps.note: Foundation: meta directories + skill scaffold (independent, parallel-safe)
New agents: knowledge-curator + research-scout + source schema (all depend on T-001, independent of each other)
Contracts + coordinator wiring (T-005 depends on T-004, T-007 depends on T-006)
Synthesis coordinator + task-signal-analyzer (T-009 depends on T-004+T-006, T-010 depends on T-001)
Context-signal-analyzer (depends on T-010 for task-signals cross-ref)
Knowledge-integrator (depends on T-010, T-011 signal files)
Skill-rebuilder (depends on T-012 for updated index, T-002 for skill directory)
All 7 downstream consumer modifications (depend on T-005/T-006 contracts, independent of each other)
Invariant supremacy rule across all 7 modified agents (depends on T-014..T-020)
Orchestrator agents array update (depends on T-004, T-009)
Routing table expansion to 9 rows (depends on T-022)
Re-entry logic + post-dispatch actions (both depend on T-023, independent)
Guide update + bootstrap header (T-027 depends on T-022..T-026, T-029 depends on T-001+T-003)
